results.title: Panchalingeswar Temple Gate Closed as Heavy Rain Intensifies Water Flow
results.description: #ଭ ୋ_ଭୋ_କାନ୍ଦିଲେ_କାଉଡିଆ ଲଗାଣ ବର୍ଷା ଯୋଗୁଁ ପଞ୍ଚଲିଙ୍ଗେଶ୍ବର ଶୈବପୀଠ ଉପରେ ଝରପାଣି ଅଧିକ ତୀବ୍ରତା ଯୋଗୁ ବନ୍ଦ ରହିଛି ପୀଠ ଫାଟକ। ସେପଟେ ଶ୍ରାବଣ ସୋମବାର ଯୋଗୁ ହଜାର ହଜାର କାଉଡ଼ିଆ ଆଜି ପୀଠ ମୁହାଁ ହୋଇଛନ୍ତି। ବହୁ ଦୂରରେ ଆସି ବାବାଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଜଳାଭିଷେକ ନକରିପରିବାରୁ ଭକ୍ତ ନିଜକୁ ନିଜେ ପାପି ଭାବ ନିଜକୁ ଧିକାର ମଧ୍ୟ କରି କାନ୍ଦୁଥିବ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳିଛି। #TempleNews_Panchalingeswar #ShravanMonday_Panchalingeswar #OdishaTemple_Panchalingeswar #Devotees_Jalabhishek #PanchalingeswarTemple_Closure #ShravanMonday_Jalabhishek #KanwariyaPilgrimage_Odisha #OdishaTV #OTV he gate of Panchalingeswar Shaiva Peetha has remained closed due to the intensified flow of cascading water caused by continuous rainfall. The situation has restricted access to the shrine on Shravan Monday.Thousands of Kanwariyas headed toward the shrine to perform Jalabhishek for Baba. However, many devotees who had travelled long distances were unable to offer water and perform the ritual.
